description: Approve an objective the negotiator marked as met, so its flat bonus is paid at settlement. Review the evidence from get_negotiation first. Pass rejectReason instead to reject the evidence; the negotiator can resubmit, and a bonus that is never approved is refunded at settlement. Approval is idempotent. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

rejectReason.description: Omit to approve. Provide a reason to reject the submitted evidence instead; the negotiator can resubmit.
rejectReason.title: maxLength(1000)

title: Review negotiation objective
